Description: SolverDiagnostic currently includes code, severity, source, message, and optional affected_ref, but lacks class, remediation, provenance, and canonical model-reference binding fields required by the PKG-02 diagnostic/result-envelope contracts.
ProposedDisposition: Technical disposition proposed: SolverDiagnostic now carries diagnostic class, remediation, provenance, optional CanonicalModelReference, and optional quantity unit metadata; helper methods expose PKG-02 analysis-boundary class/source strings. Evidence: cargo test --manifest-path core/solver/diagnostics/Cargo.toml passed 15 tests on 2026-05-16.

Description: SolverStatus uses solver-local states that are not yet mapped to PKG-02 analysis_status values, authority levels, and status_evidence_ref semantics.
ProposedDisposition: Technical disposition proposed: SolverStatus now maps to PKG-02 mechanics statuses MODEL_INCOMPLETE or MECHANICS_SOLVED under solver_result_only authority, keeps human_review_required true, and never emits rule or human-acceptance statuses. Evidence: solver_status_maps_to_analysis_boundary_without_human_authority passed in cargo test --manifest-path core/solver/diagnostics/Cargo.toml on 2026-05-16.
